cards.title: Add your baby to health insurance
cards.body: You are likely eligible to add your baby to your health insurance outside the usual sign-up period, but only for a short time. Do this by 2026-11-02.

cards.title: Reimburse your Frida baby thermometer
cards.body: You paid $28.99 at Target for Frida baby thermometer. It is likely eligible (Baby thermometer), so you may be able to reimburse it from your health FSA or HSA.

cards.title: Your daycare payments may qualify for a Dependent Care FSA
cards.body: You paid $5,550.00 to Bright Horizons in 3 payments this year. Your employer offers a Dependent Care FSA (a work account that lets you pay for daycare with pre-tax dollars, up to $7,500.00 a year). You are likely eligible to pay up to $5,550.00 of daycare with pre-tax dollars. This is eligible spend, not money back.

cards.title: Recall alert: KEAWIS Crib Mattress
cards.body: You bought "KEAWIS Crib Mattress, Dual-Sided Firm Baby Mattress" on 2026-09-10. Yixing Trading Recalls KEAWIS Crib Mattresses Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Entrapment and Suffocation; Violates Mandatory Standard for Crib Mattresses (recall date 2026-01-15). Check the official notice and stop using the item if it is the same product.

cards.title: Start or change your Dependent Care FSA
cards.body: Your employer offers a Dependent Care FSA (a work account for daycare costs), and you are likely eligible to start or change it because of your new baby. Do this by 2026-11-02.

cards.title: Federal Child Tax Credit
cards.body: You are likely eligible for the federal Child Tax Credit, worth up to $2,200.00. You claim it on your yearly tax return.

cards.title: Massachusetts Child and Family Tax Credit
cards.body: As a Massachusetts resident, you are likely eligible for the state Child and Family Tax Credit of $440.00, claimed on your state tax return.

cards.title: Massachusetts Paid Family and Medical Leave
cards.body: You are likely eligible for Massachusetts Paid Family and Medical Leave, which may pay you while you are off work with your baby. Do this by 2027-10-03.
